label_rationale: collateral is settled before the ERC721 notification and the function is nonReentrant
mechanism: Omni Protocol (Jul 2022): ERC721 onERC721Received reentrancy; collateral withdrawal notifies the owner before settling, enabling borrow against in-flight collateral
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'collateralOf', 'debtOf', 'totalCollateral']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for OmniLendPatched
  target property phi : debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller]
  exposure site       : withdrawCollateral.onERC721Received  (receiver hook)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During withdrawCollateral's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['depositCollateral', 'borrow', 'withdrawCollateral']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller] && _status == 1} pre-phase {debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller] && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller] && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_depositCollateral', 'OBL_cb_borrow', 'OBL_cb_withdrawCollateral']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller] && _status == 1 /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => debtOf[caller] <= collateralOf[caller]
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['depositCollateral', 'borrow', 'withdrawCollateral'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback borrow preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback withdrawCollateral preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
